# Acknowledgements {.unnumbered}

The CIRCL team at the Computer Incident Response Center Luxembourg produced this book. It draws on the coordinated vulnerability disclosure (CVD) work of Alexandre Dulaunoy, Cédric Bonhomme, and David Cruciani.

We thank everyone who uses and contributes to Vulnerability-Lookup, including CSIRTs, fellow CNAs, and GNAs. Your feedback and contributions help improve how teams coordinate and publish disclosures.

We also thank the GCVE initiative for developing BCP-02, the practical guide that informs the disclosure process in this book. [GCVE BCP-02](https://gcve.eu/bcp/gcve-bcp-02/)
